raw_segments.text: They all had a listless and dreary air of waiting somebody's pleasure, and the most
talkative of the ladies had to speak quite rigidly to repress a yawn.
This lady, whose name was Camilla, very much reminded me of my sister, with the difference
that she was older, and as I found when I caught sight of her of a blunter cast of features.
Indeed, when I knew her better I began to think it was a mercy she had any features
at all, so very blank and high was the dead wall of her face.
